covers: Accounts, Sales, Project Office and UI department work screens, plus a check that the older modules still work
before_you_start: Use a dummy project called TEST - Demo Website, so real data stays clean. There is no delete for projects; finish by terminating the dummy ones.
Notifications go to real people. Tell the Sales, Accounts and PMO teams that a test is running.

Testers: a Sales person (for example Ann), an Accounts person (for example Ameesha), a PMO project manager (a PMO 1 or PMO 2 team lead), a coordinator (a PMO team member), a Super Admin, and one ordinary employee from another team (for example HTML).
Tick Pass or Fail for every step. For a Fail, write the page, what you clicked, what you expected and what happened, and attach a screenshot.

sections.title: A. Main chain: lead to a working project
sections.intro: The happy path. Run these in order; each step depends on the one before.

steps.do: Add a lead 'TEST Client', value 50,000, status Hot
steps.expect: Appears in the list. Dashboard 'Hot leads' goes up by 1

steps.do: Add a proposal item due today
steps.expect: Shows in Sales > Inbox. Dashboard 'Pending actions' goes up by 1

steps.do: Mark it Done with an outcome and a next follow-up date
steps.expect: Item leaves the inbox. The lead's next follow-up date changes

steps.do: Create 'TEST - Demo Website' from the lead: CMS, WordPress, 10 pages, budget 50,000
steps.expect: Project shows as Planning and Advance awaiting. The lead becomes Won

steps.where: Notification bell, then Accounts > Projects & Payments
steps.do: Read the notice, then open Manage on the project
steps.expect: Notice 'New project awaiting advance'. Contract 50,000, state Advance awaiting

steps.do: Add an advance of 15,000, then click Approve
steps.expect: State becomes Pending payment. Balance 35,000

steps.do: Check notifications
steps.expect: 'Payment approved' notice has arrived

steps.do: Assign a coordinator (a PMO team member)
steps.expect: Coordinator receives 'New project assigned'

steps.do: Click Accept this project
steps.expect: Status becomes Active. Sales and the PMO managers are notified

steps.do: Give Design 30,000 and HTML 20,000, then Save
steps.expect: Allocated 50,000, unallocated 0

steps.do: Fill in the form and save, then reopen the tab
steps.expect: The text is still there

steps.do: Add a logo link, then remove it
steps.expect: It appears in the list, and Remove works

sections.title: B. Locks and overrides
sections.intro: Create a second TEST project and approve no payment on it.

steps.do: Open the tab on the unpaid project
steps.expect: Lock message and no form. A padlock shows on the tab

steps.do: Look for the payment override
steps.expect: Not offered. Only the Super Admin can override payment

steps.do: Override payment with a reason
steps.expect: Tab opens. The override and its reason show on the Budget tab

steps.where: A paid project with no department budget, UI tab
steps.do: Open the UI, UX, Dev and QA tabs
steps.expect: Locked until a department budget exists

steps.do: Override the budget lock with a reason
steps.expect: UI, UX, Dev and QA tabs open

steps.where: Project Office > Overview > Hold or resume
steps.do: Hold with reason 'Waiting for content'
steps.expect: List shows the reason. Sales, Accounts and the coordinator get a notice

steps.do: Choose reason Other with no note
steps.expect: Refused until a note is written

steps.do: Click Resume project
steps.expect: Status returns to Active. The reason clears

steps.do: Hold your own project with a reason, then Resume it, then Terminate it
steps.expect: A reason is always required. Accounts and the PMO are told

steps.do: Hold, Resume, then Terminate with a reason
steps.expect: A reason is required. Terminate asks for confirmation

steps.do: Request 'Add blog module', 3.5 days
steps.expect: Appears as Pending. PMO managers get a notice

steps.do: Approve it
steps.expect: Status Approved. Sales is told to agree the extra cost with the client; the coordinator is told too

steps.do: Reject another request with no note
steps.expect: Refused until a note is written

steps.do: Reject it with a note
steps.expect: Status Rejected. The coordinator and Sales are told

steps.do: Open the page
steps.expect: Only your own requests show, with no Approve or Reject buttons

steps.do: Raise 50,000 to 60,000 with a reason
steps.expect: Contract shows 60,000. Super Admin gets a notice

steps.do: Try a lower number
steps.expect: Refused

steps.do: Add a payment, then Reject it with a reason
steps.expect: A reason is required. It does not count as received

steps.do: Set a target for Ann this month (the list shows the Sales team members), then save a different number
steps.expect: One target per person per month; the second save updates it. Sales dashboard shows achieved vs target

steps.do: Add an AMC that ended last month and one that ends in 10 days
steps.expect: First shows Expired. 'Expiring in 30 days' lists only the second

steps.do: Check each tile against your leads and projects
steps.expect: Leads to follow up, hot, ready to close with value, conversion %, target, projects ongoing, pending actions, meetings, proposals all match

steps.do: Mark a lead Lost with no reason, then with a reason
steps.expect: Refused, then accepted. Conversion % changes

steps.do: Look at the list
steps.expect: Only your own leads. The Sales team lead and Super Admin see everyone's

sections.title: G. Access: these should be blocked

steps.do: Look for Sales, Accounts and Project Office
steps.expect: None of them appear

steps.do: Open them directly
steps.expect: 'Not switched on for your account'

steps.do: Open them directly
steps.expect: 'Not switched on for your account'

steps.do: Look for a project assigned to someone else
steps.expect: Not listed, and opening its link is refused

sections.title: I. UI department work screens
sections.intro: Run after section A. Needs a project with a Design budget (section A, step 10) and people in the Design team: a UI lead (team lead) and a designer.

steps.where: My Work > the project > UI pages
steps.do: Add two pages, 'Contact' and 'Careers'
steps.expect: Both appear in the list as Pending. 'Pages 2 of N sold' is shown

steps.do: Set budget 12,000, sections planned 2, assign the designer; Save details
steps.expect: Saved. The designer gets a 'Page assigned' notice

steps.do: Try a page budget bigger than the whole design budget
steps.expect: Refused with a sentence about the design budget

steps.do: Find the project, set Contact to Ongoing, open it and add two sections
steps.expect: Project is on the list. Status changes. Both sections appear

steps.do: Add a third section
steps.expect: Refused: 'set up for 2 sections'. A sub-section under a section is still allowed

steps.do: Set Completed
steps.expect: UI lead and coordinator get a 'Page completed' notice; History lists the change with your name

steps.do: Choose Correction 1, update type 'correction', note 'Logo too small'
steps.expect: Status changes. History shows the note

steps.where: Add page beyond the number sold
steps.do: Add pages until you pass the number in the sale
steps.expect: The extra page says 'Waiting for project manager'. The PMO manager can approve or reject it (a reason is needed to reject)

steps.do: Open a project where HTML has no budget
steps.expect: Refused

steps.do: Log in and log out; try a wrong password 11 times for one email
steps.expect: Works. The 11th wrong try is blocked for that email only, and others can still log in

steps.do: Apply for leave; the team lead then approves it
steps.expect: Request, approval and balance behave as before

steps.do: Check in and check out
steps.expect: Times recorded as before

steps.do: Submit a travel allowance request
steps.expect: Appears in TA status; approvers can act on it

steps.do: Send a message; open notifications
steps.expect: Both work

steps.do: Open the dashboard
steps.expect: Alerts and recent activity widgets load

sections.title: N. Appreciation, meetings, feedback, AMC, Sales reply
sections.intro: New and switched off until released. Switch on module.appreciation, meetings and customer_feedback first.

steps.do: Nominate a colleague with a title and reason
steps.expect: Nomination appears as Pending; HR and the project manager are notified

steps.do: Open the page or try to nominate
steps.expect: Not available to a plain team member

steps.do: Reject without a reason, then approve
steps.expect: Reject asks for a reason; approve shows it on the Hall page and posts an announcement; nominee and nominator are told

steps.do: Schedule a client meeting with a colleague and a client email
steps.expect: Invite emails with a calendar file go out; the colleague is notified

steps.do: Save minutes and add a follow-up for a colleague
steps.expect: Meeting becomes Done; the colleague can tick the follow-up off

steps.do: Open someone else's meeting
steps.expect: Refused

steps.do: Record feedback 'during project'; try 'after go-live'
steps.expect: During works; after go-live is refused

steps.do: Record feedback for a project not yet live, then a live one
steps.expect: Refused until the project is live, then saved

steps.do: Open the page; enter an AMC ending in 10 days
steps.expect: Live projects only; shows Expiring soon; reminder arrives once

steps.do: Raise an out-of-scope request
steps.expect: The salesperson is notified and sees Action required

steps.do: Approve without a reason, then with one; request a meeting on another
steps.expect: Reason is required; meeting creates a client meeting inviting the Project Office

steps.do: Open the page with one project over its department budgets and one at 95%
steps.expect: The first is under Over the limit with the overrun and department breakdown; the second under Nearing the limit

steps.do: Open the page
steps.expect: Refused: manager only

steps.do: Drag an Active project to On Hold and choose a reason; drag it back
steps.expect: Status changes, stakeholders are told; cards show budget left

steps.do: Drag a Planning project to Active
steps.expect: Refused with an explanation; it moves by the coordinator accepting

steps.do: Open the page and filter by department
steps.expect: Per person: tasks done and on time, effort spent vs estimate, QA bugs, feedback scores; no rating column

steps.do: Try to open it
steps.expect: Not available

changelog.text: Version 1.5. Section N extended with the out-of-budget list, tracker and HR performance figures.
Version 1.4. New section N: appreciation, meetings, customer feedback, Sales AMC and the Sales out-of-scope reply (all built, not yet run).
Version 1.2. New section I: UI department work screens (pages, sections, status chain, page budgets).

Version 1.1. Refused actions now show a full sentence instead of 'Required.' (sections C, D). The sales-target person list now comes from the Sales team (section E). Steps in A to H were also run by Claude on a local copy: 36 of 40 passed, the 4 failures were fixed. The re-run after the fixes passed 40 of 40.
Version 1.0. First test script, covering Accounts, Sales and Project Office, and the older-modules check.
